title: Intro to C on Windows - Day 1
summary: Day 1 of Handmade Hero's introduction to C on Windows, covering setting up Visual Studio, creating a Win32 project, the WinMain entry point and writing a first function. It is the starting point for Casey Muratori's from-scratch game series.
why: HN recommends it as an approachable way into C and low-level programming that gets to something visible quickly.
